8.3.13 Eth_GetSpiStatus
[SWS_Eth_91012]{DRAFT} Definition of API function Eth_GetSpiStatus ⌈
Service Name
Eth_GetSpiStatus (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Eth_GetSpiStatus (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_SpiStatusType* SpiStatusType
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1E
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller within the context of the Ethernet Driver
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
SpiStatusType
MACPHY status
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: success,
E_NOT_OK: Status could not be obtained
Description
Returns the status defined by OA TC6 [26] to identify if an error can occured at the SPI
interface.
Tags: atp.Status=draft

Eth.h
